rules.description: At least three UDP datagrams beginning with the four-byte IOT1 prefix.
SYN connection attempt to the HTTP API.
GET marker bytes are present on the HTTP API transport; assert the decoded query result.
HTTP 200 marker bytes are present on the HTTP API transport.
Telemetry contains bytes after IOT1. The E1 JSON/TLV decoder and tests verify device_id, ts, seq and value.

manual_checks: Decode the payload after IOT1 with the E1 JSON/TLV schema and demonstrate device_id, ts, seq and value.
Correlate seq values with deduplication/out-of-order tests; presence of the ASCII word seq is not a binary-format requirement.
R1 R5: Decode device_id, ts, seq and value and test invalid prefix, duplicate/out-of-order data and bounds.
R2 R3 R4: Assert that the returned device, sequence and value match the injected measurement; demonstrate the mandatory E3 stream separately.
